verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms usage-based billing via usage events ingestion, multi-frequency subscriptions, and addons/charges/coupons/discounts, which supports a general usage-metering and pricing framework, but there is no explicit documentation of tiered, volume, graduated, or per-unit pricing models, nor of credits, commitments, or overage handling — the specific configurable pricing structures the story asks about. missing for 10: explicit docs on tiered/volume/graduated/per-unit pricing tiers, credit/commitment mechanics, overage billing rules, and confirmation these are configurable without custom code.
